title: Parts of Speech – ಪದಗಳ ಎಂಟು ವರ್ಗ (ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗದ ಆಳ ಪರಿಚಯ)
content:
Grammar Foundation • KEA Paper-2

✦ Noun & Pronoun – ವಿವರವಾಗಿ

• Noun ಎಂದರೆ: ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ, ವಸ್ತು, ಸ್ಥಳ, ಭಾವನೆಯ ಹೆಸರು. ಐದು ವಿಧ – Proper Noun (ವಿಶೇಷ ಹೆಸರು: Bengaluru, Kaveri, Ramesh – ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ Capital Letter!), Common Noun (ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ: city, river, boy), Collective Noun (ಗುಂಪು: team, army, flock of birds, bunch of keys), Material Noun (ವಸ್ತುದ್ರವ್ಯ: gold, milk, cotton), Abstract Noun (ಭಾವ: honesty, courage, childhood). ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'Identify the abstract noun' ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
• Countable vs Uncountable: ಎಣಿಸಬಹುದಾದವು Countable (book–books, chair–chairs); ಎಣಿಸಲಾಗದವು Uncountable (water, rice, information, furniture, advice, news – ಇವಕ್ಕೆ ಬಹುವಚನ ಇಲ್ಲ!). ತಪ್ಪು: informations, furnitures, advices ✗. 'Much' Uncountable ಜೊತೆ (much water), 'Many' Countable ಜೊತೆ (many books) – ಇದು KEA ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ error-spotting ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ.
• ವಿಶೇಷ ಬಹುವಚನಗಳು (ನೆನಪಿಡಿ): child→children; man→men; woman→women; foot→feet; tooth→teeth; mouse→mice; ox→oxen; sheep→sheep (ಬದಲಾಗದು); deer→deer; leaf→leaves; knife→knives; city→cities; hero→heroes; photo→photos; datum→data; criterion→criteria. Scissors, trousers, spectacles ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಬಹುವಚನ.
• Pronoun ವಿಧಗಳು: Personal (I, we, you, he, she, it, they – subject form; me, us, him, her, them – object form), Possessive (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs), Reflexive (myself, yourself, himself, themselves – 'He hurt himself'), Demonstrative (this, that, these, those), Interrogative (who, whom, whose, which, what), Relative (who, which, that – ಎರಡು ವಾಕ್ಯ ಬೆಸೆಯುವವು), Indefinite (somebody, anyone, nothing, each, none).
• ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ನಿಯಮಗಳು: (1) Who–ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ, Which–ವಸ್ತು/ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗೆ, That–ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ. (2) 'Between you and me' ✓ (between you and I ✗ – preposition ನಂತರ object form). (3) Each, every, either, neither ನಂತರ singular verb – 'Each of the boys was present' ✓. (4) 'One should do one's duty' ('his duty' ಅಲ್ಲ, one ಬಂದರೆ one's ಬರಬೇಕು).

✦ Verb, Adverb & Adjective – ವಿವರವಾಗಿ

• Verb ವಿಧಗಳು: Main Verb (ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ: eat, go, write) ಮತ್ತು Auxiliary/Helping Verb (ಸಹಾಯಕ: is, am, are, was, were, has, have, had, do, does, did + Modals: can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must, ought to). Transitive verb ಗೆ object ಬೇಕು ('She wrote a letter' – what? a letter); Intransitive ಗೆ ಬೇಡ ('He sleeps').
• Modal ನಿಯಮಗಳು (KEA ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಖಚಿತ): Can–ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ (I can swim); Could–ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ/ವಿನಯದ ಕೋರಿಕೆ (Could you help me?); May–ಅನುಮತಿ/ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ (May I come in?); Might–ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ; Must–ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ (You must obey rules); Should–ಸಲಹೆ (You should exercise daily); Would–ವಿನಯದ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥನೆ; Ought to–ನೈತಿಕ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ. Modal ನಂತರ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ V1 (base form): 'He can speaks' ✗ → 'He can speak' ✓.
• Adjective ಹೋಲಿಕೆಯ ಮೂರು ಹಂತ: Positive–Comparative–Superlative: tall–taller–tallest; good–better–best; bad–worse–worst; little–less–least; many/much–more–most; far–farther–farthest; beautiful–more beautiful–most beautiful. ನಿಯಮ: ಇಬ್ಬರ ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗೆ Comparative + than ('Rama is taller than Krishna'); ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ Superlative + the ('He is the tallest in the class'). Double comparative ತಪ್ಪು: 'more taller' ✗.
• Adverb ಸ್ಥಾನ ನಿಯಮ: ಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಹೇಗೆ/ಎಲ್ಲಿ/ಯಾವಾಗ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುವ ಪದ Adverb. Manner (slowly, bravely), Time (now, yesterday, soon), Place (here, everywhere), Frequency (always, often, never, sometimes – ಇವು ಮುಖ್ಯ verb ಮುಂದೆ: 'He always comes late' ✓, 'He comes always late' ✗), Degree (very, too, quite). 'Very' + adjective (very good); 'Much' + comparative (much better) – ಈ ಜೋಡಿ error ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
• Conjunction & Interjection: Conjunction ವಾಕ್ಯ/ಪದ ಬೆಸೆಯುವ ಪದ – and, but, or, because, although, since, unless, while; ಜೋಡಿ conjunctions ನೆನಪಿಡಿ: Not only...but also; Either...or; Neither...nor; Both...and; So...that; Hardly...when; No sooner...than. Interjection ಭಾವಸೂಚಕ – Alas! (ದುಃಖ), Hurrah! (ಸಂತೋಷ), Bravo! (ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ), Oh! (ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ).

✦ Subject–Verb Agreement – 12 ಚಿನ್ನದ ನಿಯಮಗಳು

• ನಿಯಮ 1–4: (1) Singular subject → singular verb: 'The boy plays'; Plural → plural: 'The boys play'. (2) ಎರಡು subject 'and' ನಿಂದ ಸೇರಿದರೆ plural verb: 'Rama and Sita are here'. ಆದರೆ ಒಂದೇ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ/ಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಆದರೆ singular: 'Rice and curry is my favourite food'. (3) Each/Every/Either/Neither → singular: 'Every student has a book'. (4) 'Or/Nor' ಬೆಸೆದಾಗ ಹತ್ತಿರದ subject ಗೆ verb ಹೊಂದಬೇಕು: 'Neither he nor his friends were present'.
• ನಿಯಮ 5–8: (5) Collective noun ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ singular: 'The team is playing well'. (6) 'News, Mathematics, Physics, Politics, Economics' – ರೂಪ plural ಆದರೂ singular verb: 'Mathematics is difficult'. (7) ಸಮಯ/ಹಣ/ದೂರದ ಮೊತ್ತ singular: 'Ten kilometres is a long distance'; 'Five hundred rupees is enough'. (8) 'The number of' → singular ('The number of students is fifty'); 'A number of' → plural ('A number of students are absent').
• ನಿಯಮ 9–12: (9) 'One of the + plural noun + singular verb': 'One of my friends is a doctor' ('are' ✗). (10) 'Many a + singular noun + singular verb': 'Many a man was killed'. (11) Subject ಮತ್ತು verb ನಡುವಿನ 'with, along with, as well as, besides' ಗಳ ಪದಗುಚ್ಛ verb ಅನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸದು: 'The teacher, along with the students, was present'. (12) 'There' ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಜವಾದ subject ನಂತರ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ: 'There are many books on the table'.
• KEA ಮಾದರಿ error ಗಳು: 'He do not know' ✗ → does not; 'She have a car' ✗ → has; 'The quality of these mangoes are good' ✗ → is (subject = quality); 'Everyone were happy' ✗ → was; 'Bread and butter are his only food' ✗ → is (ಒಂದೇ ಆಹಾರ ಕಲ್ಪನೆ). Error-spotting ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು subject ಹುಡುಕಿ, ಅದರ ವಚನ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ – ಇದೇ ಗೆಲುವಿನ ದಾರಿ.

✦ Question Tags & Degrees – ಪೂರಕ ನಿಯಮ

• Question Tag ಸೂತ್ರ: ವಾಕ್ಯ Positive ಆದರೆ tag Negative; ವಾಕ್ಯ Negative ಆದರೆ tag Positive. ಅದೇ auxiliary verb + pronoun ಬಳಸಿ. 'You are a student, aren't you?'; 'She can sing, can't she?'; 'He doesn't smoke, does he?'; 'They went home, didn't they?' (auxiliary ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ do/does/did ಬಳಸಿ).
• ವಿಶೇಷ Tags (ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಟ್ರಿಕ್): 'I am' ಗೆ tag 'aren't I?' ('amn't I' ✗); 'Let us go' ಗೆ 'shall we?'; ಆಜ್ಞೆಗೆ (Imperative) 'will you?/won't you?' – 'Open the door, will you?'; 'Everyone/Everybody' ಗೆ 'they' – 'Everybody came, didn't they?'; ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ never, hardly, scarcely, rarely ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದು Negative ಎಂದೇ ಪರಿಗಣನೆ – tag Positive: 'He never lies, does he?'
• Degrees of Comparison ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ: ಒಂದೇ ಅರ್ಥದ ಮೂರು ರೂಪ – Superlative: 'Kaveri is the longest river in Karnataka' = Comparative: 'Kaveri is longer than any other river in Karnataka' = Positive: 'No other river in Karnataka is as long as Kaveri'. ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'any other' (comparative ರೂಪ) ಮತ್ತು 'No other' (positive ರೂಪ) ಪದಗಳ ಬಳಕೆಯೇ ಕೀಲಿ – ಈ ಮೂರು ರೂಪಾಂತರ KEA ಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ.

★ Exam Key Points

• Error ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್: informations✗ furnitures✗ advices✗; can speaks✗→can speak; more taller✗; between you and I✗→me; The number of...is✓; One of the boys is✓; Mathematics is✓.
• Tag ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್: I am→aren't I; Let us→shall we; ಆಜ್ಞೆ→will you; never/hardly ಇದ್ದರೆ→positive tag.

◆ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್ ಸರಪಳಿ
